topStories.headline: Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 with extended thinking and tool use improvements
topStories.summary: Major model upgrade with significant gains in reasoning, code generation, and agentic workflows. Pricing unchanged for existing tiers.
topStories.whyItMatters: Direct impact on current tooling stack. Evaluate upgrade path and test against existing prompts.

topStories.headline: OpenAI announces GPT-5 with real-time reasoning capabilities
topStories.summary: GPT-5 introduces persistent reasoning chains and 2M context. Enterprise pricing starts at $200/seat. Available via API immediately.
topStories.whyItMatters: Track OpenAI for execution-relevant AI developments and pricing/regulatory shifts.

topStories.headline: Microsoft integrates Copilot deeply into Windows 12 preview
topStories.summary: System-level AI assistant handles file management, scheduling, and cross-app workflows. Enterprise rollout Q3.
topStories.whyItMatters: Track Microsoft/Azure AI for execution-relevant AI developments and pricing/regulatory shifts.

topStories.headline: Google DeepMind open-sources Gemma 3 model family
topStories.summary: Gemma 3 models (2B, 9B, 27B) released under permissive license. Strong benchmarks on code and reasoning.
topStories.whyItMatters: Potential cost savings for lightweight tasks. Evaluate for on-device or self-hosted use cases.

topStories.headline: Meta launches open-source AI agent framework
topStories.summary: New framework for building multi-step AI agents. Integrates with LLaMA models.
topStories.whyItMatters: Monitor for ecosystem shifts. No immediate action needed.

whyItMatters.assessment: Claude and GPT-5 pricing converging. Current spend may drop 15-25% if switching tiers or renegotiating.
whyItMatters.recommendedAction: Benchmark current usage against new pricing tiers before next billing cycle

whyItMatters.assessment: Accelerated timeline means compliance work should start now if any AI tools are EU-facing.
whyItMatters.recommendedAction: Audit current AI usage for EU exposure; flag any high-risk categorizations

whyItMatters.assessment: Gemma 3 and LLaMA improvements closing gap with proprietary models for specific tasks.
